description: The General Court number session the vote took place
The count of a roll call vote within a General Court session. Increments starting from 0
Unique identifier used by the MA legislature to identify representatives within their system
The actual vote made on a roll call vote instance. Valid values include Y N X and P
A bit that represents where a voter is the Speaker of the House
A bit that represents whether a vote was taken after the fact
The string of the name of the bill being voted on
The date a roll call vote took place. Takes the format mm/dd/yyyy
The time a roll call vote took place. Takes the format HH:MM AM/PM
The number of yea votes for a given roll call vote. This value is parsed from the raw PDF of a roll call vote and is used for validation purposes
The number of nay votes for a given roll call vote. This value is parsed from the raw PDF of a roll call vote and is used for validation purposes
The number of not-voting votes for a given roll call vote. This value is parsed from the raw PDF of a roll call vote and is used for validation purposes
A bit that represents whether a given vote passed validation checks done in the cleaning pipeline
The full name (typically first and last but may include additional names) of a voting representative
The branch of government a member serves in. Is always "house" for this dataset but came from a table of representatives that was merged into this dataset
The party a representative is affiliated with
The district a representative is elected to represent. This may change over time for a representative and is only associated with a given legislative general court session
The calendar year a general court session is associated with
